content:
Jon Hamm and his wife, Anna Osceola, are officially parents.

The “Mad Men” alums welcomed their first child together, a baby boy, sources close to the couple confirmed to People on Thursday. Representatives for the two didn’t immediately respond to HuffPost’s request for comment.

The Daily Mail first reported in August that Hamm, 55, and Osceola, 38, were expecting their first child together. The pair started dating in 2020, five years after crossing paths on the “Mad Men” series finale in 2015. Hamm proposed to Osceola in February 2023 and they tied the knot that June in Big Sur, California.

Hamm previously dated ex Jennifer Westfeldt for 18 years. The ex-couple confirmed their split in a joint statement to multiple outlets in September 2015.

Hamm expressed enthusiasm over becoming a parent in an appearance on the “Today” show back in September.

“The best thing I keep hearing is how much it changes you for the better, and I’m excited,” he said then.

“I’ve been around kids my whole life. I’ve been a teacher, my nieces and nephews and all that stuff. I’m excited to start our own family ― it’s thrilling. And terrifying,” Hamm added.
